production_readiness.justification: Held-out 2025 test set contains 65 valid rows (9 severe-outbreak positives, 13.85% prevalence) for target_severe_outbreak_p75 and 78 rows (13 fatal-outbreak positives, 16.67% prevalence) for target_fatal_outbreak. While mortality risk (target_fatal_outbreak) and 4-week recurrence achieve strong held-out generalization, case-count severity exceedance (target_severe_outbreak_p75) has moderate PR-AUC due to small per-disease sample sizes and sparse event-only IDSP reporting.

phase6_disease_forecasting_engine.native_reporting_frequency: weekly (7-day IDSP reporting periods W01..W52; daily predictions are never fabricated)

7d.label: 7_days_1_reporting_week_ahead
7d.description: 1 native IDSP reporting week ahead (7 days) from cutoff t-1; uses features strictly <= t-1.

14d.label: 14_days_2_reporting_weeks_ahead
14d.description: 2 native IDSP reporting weeks ahead (14 days) from cutoff t-2; excludes lag-1 features.

30d.label: 30_days_4_reporting_weeks_ahead
30d.description: 4 native IDSP reporting weeks ahead (28 days, closest weekly multiple to 30 days) from cutoff t-4; excludes lags 1..3.

production_readiness.justification: Weekly outbreak case counts exhibit extreme right-skewness (median 16-22 cases, with isolated point-source food-poisoning and diarrhoeal spikes up to 651-1,000 cases). Log1p-transformed ML regressors and Seasonal/ETS models substantially reduce MAE and RMSE compared to the Last-Value baseline across all 3 horizons (7d, 14d, 30d) and achieve 75-92% prediction interval coverage, but point forecasts cannot anticipate sudden point-source mass gatherings.

phase7_anomaly_detection_engine.disclaimer: An anomaly is an elevated signal requiring investigation, not proof of an outbreak.

phase8_climate_disease_intelligence_engi.causality_disclaimer: Observed correlation, regression association, or ML/SHAP feature importance reflects statistical co-movement and predictive utility only; it does NOT establish causation.

spatial_weights.method_primary: Symmetric k-Nearest Neighbors (k=4) on Great-Circle Haversine Distance, Row-Standardized
spatial_weights.method_secondary_sensitivity: Inverse Haversine Distance Band (<= 220.0 km), Row-Standardized
spatial_weights.why_point_based_weights: No district polygon boundary file (.geojson/.shp) exists in the workspace. Symmetric k-NN (k=4) on verified district point coordinates guarantees a connected, island-free spatial graph across all 35 geocoded districts without inventing polygon boundaries.

phase10_spread_simulation_engine.non_prediction_disclaimer: HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO SIMULATION ONLY — NOT A REAL OUTBREAK OR DISEASE-SPREAD PREDICTION. No empirical human mobility, road-traffic, or biological transmission parameters exist in the workspace; propagation reflects user-configured graph adjacency assumptions only.

phase11_healthcare_resource_demand_engin.engine_name: Healthcare Resource Demand Intelligence & Hypothetical Scenario Calculator Engine
phase11_healthcare_resource_demand_engin.mandatory_disclaimer: NO EMPIRICAL HEALTHCARE RESOURCE DATASET EXISTS IN THE WORKSPACE. Actual hospital admissions, available/occupied beds, ICU capacity, testing volume, medicine stock, and facility counts are UNAVAILABLE (NaN) and are NEVER invented. All resource demand projections produced by the scenario calculator are HYPOTHETICAL WHAT-IF CALCULATIONS based solely on visible, user-editable assumptions.

phase12_severity_mortality_intelligence_.engine_name: Disease Severity and Mortality Intelligence Engine
phase12_severity_mortality_intelligence_.mandatory_disclaimer: AGGREGATE PUBLIC-HEALTH SURVEILLANCE ONLY — NO INDIVIDUAL PATIENT DATA OR PROGNOSIS. All mortality and case-fatality indicators are derived strictly from aggregate district-level IDSP outbreak cluster reports (2023–2025). Clinical severity counts, inpatient admissions, complications, and recovery counts do not exist in the workspace and are explicitly NaN. This engine never processes personally identifiable information (PII) and must never be used for individual clinical diagnosis, prognosis, or treatment decisions.

phase13_explainable_ai_engine.mandatory_disclaimer: FEATURE CONTRIBUTION IS NOT CAUSATION. High feature importance, positive SHAP values, or regression coefficients indicate that the model utilized a statistical pattern in the training data to form its prediction or risk score; they do NOT prove that a climate or epidemiological variable biologically or environmentally caused an outbreak.
